record: render verification — phase 12 (iteration 2). The render is the production's final step, executed from this branch's own files: the phase-9 scene + the phase-11 programme.

render.audio: AAC 192 kb/s from the verified programme WAV

inputs.procedure: CDP deterministic seek-capture of the phase-9 scene at 30 fps (2,251 frames, private Chrome port 9963) + ffmpeg mux with the programme WAV (libx264 crf 17, faststart). Capture pace note: ~0.5 s/frame under shared-VM load (a second production job was rendering concurrently); the capture is deterministic in t, so pace does not touch the artifact. An earlier mux from the programme MP3 was discarded and re-muxed from the WAV master to keep iteration 1's route; only the WAV-route file is staged.

measurements_on_the_render.loudness_verdict: inside the master band (-14 +/-1 LUFS, TP <= -1 dBTP); the AAC stage moved TP from the programme WAV's -1.52 to -1.40, still inside the ceiling

first_phrase_onset_probe.instrument: the voice track of the same programme (the bed is continuous by the owner's standing rule, so a mix-level probe reads the music, not the narration)
first_phrase_onset_probe.measured: lead-in silence ends at 0.401 s against the planned first-phrase start of 0.400 s — deviation +1 ms

pause_map_verification.instrument: silencedetect (-45 dB, min 0.20 s) on the assembled voice track — the same audio the render carries
pause_map_verification.verdict: every designed gap survives whole in the rendered programme, including the 1.00 s designed silence before the payoff (measured 1.001 s) and the 0.90 s suspension after the flat picture (measured 0.986 s speech-free, the balance being the breath into L2)

frame_qa.scene_level: 13 timestamps captured from the branch's scene and viewed (5, 24, 30.5, 31, 33.5, 38, 40, 44, 48, 54, 55.5, 57.5, 63, 70, 74.5 s across the passes); seven defects found by eye and fixed (scene/scene.json eye_qa)
frame_qa.render_level: four frames extracted from the delivered MP4 (33.5 / 48 / 63 / 74.5 s); the sphere frame (48 s) viewed: wire sphere clean, vector embedded, no residual incoming arrows, MEGA PROMPT monumental over the ghosted origin cards

editability_proof.procedure: the phase-9 scene opened with ?render&edit=1 (private Chrome port 9965): a word (L8 'decisions,') clicked -> inspector opened -> an edit saved (dy +140) -> reload: the word's rendered transform carried translateY(140px), the saved overlay read back from localStorage -> edits cleared -> reload: the word's transform returned to the baseline translateY(0px) scale(1)
editability_proof.verdict: the changed scene is a living artifact on the same proof standard as iteration 1: readable, clickable, editable, persistent, reversible
